context: Two teens swap weekend cinema-and-food plans
purpose: Teach: ドリーム/シアター/シネマ/刺身/タコ/ロイヤル/インテル/レーベル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ陸、土曜の夜、駅前のドリームシアターで新作観ない？
lines.en: Hey Riku, want to see the new movie at Dream Theater by the station Saturday night?
lines.style: Casual teen girl voice, bright and inviting tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おっ、いいね。あそこのシネマ、座席めっちゃ広いんだよな。
lines.en: Oh, nice. That cinema has really wide seats, you know.
lines.style: Relaxed teen boy, casual and slightly enthusiastic delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でしょ？で、観たあとロイヤルホストでご飯どう？
lines.en: Right? And how about dinner at Royal Host afterward?
lines.style: Excited teen girl, rising playful intonation throughout.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うーん、ファミレスもいいけど、俺は刺身が食べたい気分かな。
lines.en: Hmm, family restaurant is fine, but I'm kind of in the mood for sashimi.
lines.style: Thoughtful teen boy, slightly hungry musing tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ回転寿司にしよ！タコ好きでしょ、確か。
lines.en: Then let's do conveyor-belt sushi! You like octopus, right?
lines.style: Cheerful teen girl, quick and decisive suggestion.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: よく覚えてんな。あ、そういえば新しいパソコン買ったよ、インテルの最新の。
lines.en: You remember well. Oh, by the way, I got a new PC, the latest Intel one.
lines.style: Surprised teen boy, switching to casual brag mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ、すごい。じゃあ家帰ったら、私の好きなレーベルの曲送るね。
lines.en: Whoa, cool. So when you get home, I'll send you songs from my favorite label.
lines.style: Impressed teen girl, friendly and slightly teasing close.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 了解。じゃあ土曜、駅で五時な。
lines.en: Got it. So Saturday, five o'clock at the station.
lines.style: Confident teen boy, short confirming sign-off tone.
